undemanding.definition: a. requiring little if any patience or effort or skill
undemanding.translation: a. 要求不高的；容易的；不严格的

undemocratic.definition: a. not in agreement with or according to democratic doctrine or practice or ideals
undemocratic.translation: a. 非民主的, 不民主的

undemonstrable.translation: a. 无法表明的, 不可论证的

undemonstrated.translation: a. 未论证的, 未证实的

undemonstrative.definition: a. not given to open expression of emotion
undemonstrative.translation: a. 不露声色的, 矜持寡言的
